4 اقحط : see 1, throughout. ―
-b2- أَقْحَطَ, said of a man, also signifies (tropical:) Semen non emisit: (Mgh, Msb:) or inivit et semen non emisit: (K:) from the same verb in the last of the senses explained in the preceding paragraph. (Mgh, Msb.) ＝
-A2- أَقْحَطَ ٱللّٰهُ الأَرْضَ God afflicted the land with drought; by withholding rain from it. (Msb, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
